finding.zhCn: 部分地址由平台或分析机构归属，不能保证完整或持续控制
finding.en: Some addresses are attributed by platforms or analysts; completeness and continuing control are not guaranteed

finding.zhCn: 项目国库、客户托管和个人钱包必须分开
finding.en: Project treasuries, customer custody, and personal wallets must be separated

finding.zhCn: 监管文件可确认部分控制关系，完整跨境结构仍不透明
finding.en: Filings confirm some control relationships; the complete cross-border structure remains opaque

finding.zhCn: 基金会、代码和发行记录确认其创始组织角色
finding.en: Foundation, code, and issuance records confirm his founding-organizer role

claim.zhCn: 个人财富等于可归属地址总值
claim.en: Personal wealth equals the value of attributed addresses

finding.zhCn: 错误；地址可能属于企业、协议、客户或受限制资产
finding.en: Incorrect; addresses may represent companies, protocols, customers, or restricted assets

claim.zhCn: SEC 对其提出证券与操纵指控
claim.en: SEC alleged securities and manipulation violations

finding.zhCn: 起诉文件确认指控；指控本身不等于法院终局认定
finding.en: The complaint confirms the allegations; allegations are not final judicial findings

openQuestions.zhCn: 代币发行所得、项目储备与个人受益权益的历史对账如何？
openQuestions.en: How do token-sale proceeds, project reserves, and personal beneficial interests reconcile historically?

openQuestions.en: What are the ultimate ownership, customer-asset segregation, and liabilities of each exchange entity?

summary.zhCn: 重构TRON发行、企业控制、链上归属和监管边界。
